name: 24LC256 I2C EEPROM
description: 256-kbit (32768 x 8) serial EEPROM on I2C (Microchip 24LC256): two address bytes, byte and 64-byte page writes with a self-timed write cycle during which it does not acknowledge, sequential reads, address from A0-A2, write protect.

pins.name: WP
pins.doc: Write protect, active high (unconnected reads low: writes enabled)

twr.doc: Write cycle time (the datasheet's maximum, 5 ms)

view_at.doc: First address of the 64 bytes the view output shows (an inspector setting, not a pin)

functional.claims: Address 0x50 + A2..A0, two address bytes (A15 don't care), byte and page writes committed at STOP with the 64-byte page wrap, no write cycle after a repeated START, sequential and current-address reads rolling over at 7FFF, no ACK during the write cycle (ACK polling), WP high blocks writes but still runs the cycle.
omissions: contents are not kept between sessions
the bus speed limits (400 kHz at 2.5 V, 1 MHz for the 24FC256): faster clocks are decoded too
the write cycle time is always twr (the datasheet's maximum), not the shorter typical
